```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(leaflet)
library(sf)  # spatial data handling             
library(leaflet) # interactive map creation       
library(htmltools) # HTML rendering for labels and popups   
library(janitor) # cleaning column names
library(tidyverse) # data manipulation and piping
library(readr)  # reading CSV files
library(dplyr)

# reading in data
aus <- read_csv("abroad/aus/aus.csv")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Create the leaflet map with an embedded image in the popup
leaflet(aus) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addMarkers(
    lat   = ~lat,
    lng   = ~long,
    popup = ~paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br>", desc, "<br><img src='", photo, "' width='200px'>")
  )
```
